title: Crash preventing an application start after updating from 3.1.0.3 to 3.2.0.3 due to DB migration failure (notes column of boluses table)
body:
I was using 3.1.0.3, some time ago I have tried a development build on a same device.
Then I've retured back to a 3.1.0.3 - there were some problems with displaying data when downgrading but application have continued to work fine.
A couple of months ago I've upgraded to a 3.1.0.3 with a set of patches for G7 data smoothing.
Today I've decided to upgrade to 3.2.0.3.
Application is crashing right on a start.

comments.body: Sorry, support is provided only on non modified versions. In your case you did some customisations which led to this error . I test db migrations only on mainstream AAPS

migration21to22 (DatabaseModule.kt) was not completely performed by a stable release plan because DB was marked as updated to a higher version while the plan was different and incomplete in a development branch causing an unexpected result.
I've took the master branch (current 3.2.0.3), played with a source code editing: downgraded the DB version to 20 in application, rewrote the migration 20 to 24 plan, then upgraded DB to 24. There were problems with an identityHash and seems that application have decided to ignore all of this, drop the whole DB and recreate it.
Now I'm back on stock stable release 3.2.0.3 from a master branch.
Will not wish to perform this exercise to anyone.

Dear Miloš @MilosKozak , would you be so kind to advise if it's possible to perform the full application backup before trying a dev branch for anything on a live set up on a non-rooted device?
AAPS can recover database from NS
